description: This file defines a Java class 'CloseLoanCommandHandler' that handles the command to close a loan in the Fineract loan management system. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and uses 'LoanWritePlatformService' to perform the close loan operation when triggered by a specific command.

classes.name: CloseLoanCommandHandler
classes.description: Handler class responsible for processing 'close loan' commands within the Fineract system.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to close a loan by invoking the loan write platform service to perform the closure.
